rows.label: Tax status: UK Overseas Territory with its own tax system
rows.value: The Virgin Islands (British) is a UK Overseas Territory with its own tax system, set by its own government and separate from the UK's; the Inland Revenue Department under the Ministry of Finance assesses and collects its taxes. Employment income is taxed through the payroll tax shared by employers and employees; social security contributions go to the Social Security Board.
